subgoals.description: Capture a fresh RGB image from the camera to provide the necessary visual data for analysis.
Utilize Gemini ER to perform visual understanding of the captured image, specifically looking for and describing any non-English language text.

Process the textual output from 'analyze_scene'. If non-English language was detected, formulate a natural-language description of it. Otherwise, generate a placeholder description indicating no target. This description will be used for the subsequent pointing action.

Attempt to point the robot to the object described by the LLM. If the LLM determined no non-English text, this skill will receive a description indicating no target, leading to an effective 'do nothing' or 'cannot find' outcome, fulfilling the 'if yes point it' condition.

assumptions: The camera provides a clear view of any potential text in the scene.
The 'analyze_scene' skill can accurately detect and identify non-English languages and provide descriptive text.
The 'llm_reason' skill can correctly interpret the 'analyze_scene' output to formulate a natural-language description for the pointing skill.
The 'point_to_object' skill can gracefully handle a scenario where the 'object_description' indicates no specific object to point to (e.g., if no non-English language is found).
